channels.title: Customer channels
channels.hint: Connect the channels your customers write to you on. Conversations arrive in Messages and are handled by anyone with the “Customer messages” permission.
channels.disconnectHint: New Telegram messages will stop arriving. Existing conversations are kept.
channels.adminOnly: Only an administrator can connect the company bot.
channels.notDelivered: Could not be delivered through the channel

telegram.description: Customers write to the company bot and the team replies from Messages.
telegram.step1: In Telegram, open @BotFather and send it /newbot.
telegram.step2: Give it the company name and a username ending in “bot”.
telegram.step3: Copy the token it gives you and paste it here.
telegram.shareHint: Share the bot link with your customers (on your website, invoices, emails) so they can write to you there.

contacts.linkHint: So you know which ERP customer this is and can open their record from the conversation.
contacts.partnerPlaceholder: Search by name, code or tax ID

meetings.linkHint: Paste the link from Meet, Teams, Zoom or whatever tool you use.

problems.title: Give it a subject.
problems.url: It must be a link starting with https://.
problems.customerAlone: A customer goes alone: they cannot join a team group.

meetings.cancelMessage: “{title}” will be cancelled for everyone in the conversation.

calendar.title: Meetings
calendar.empty: No meetings on these dates. Click a slot to schedule one.
calendar.loadError: The meetings could not be loaded.
